Incident: Payments API outage
Services: payments-api, checkout-web
Start: 2026-11-03 14:05
Detected: 14:12
Mitigated: 14:40
Resolved: 15:10
Impact: Checkout failed with HTTP 500 for about 30% of users
Detected by: PagerDuty alert on payments-api 5xx rate
Mitigation: Rolled back deploy 2291; Restarted payment workers
Fix: Reverted the config change that set the DB pool size to 5
Trigger: Config push at 14:03 lowered the DB connection pool size
Root cause: bad config push
14:03 config change deployed to payments-api
14:05 5xx rate on payments-api climbs above 20%
14:12 PagerDuty alert fires, on-call acknowledges
14:40 rollback of deploy 2291 completed
15:10 error rate back to normal, incident closed
Action: Add validation for pool size in config CI
